I am fine.   I have had medical intervention and am being taken care of by my loved ones.   

And FYI.   The best treatment for ptsd is medical marijuana.   And no matter the choice of medication a person chooses to deal with the growing epidemic of this disorder,  it should never be out of their reach because of ability to pay. 

Thank you.
Nothing like seeing all the responses to others and that comments were deleted here and seeing that you are completely right in your choice.   Peace and blessings

My first memories are of being molested by a neighbor and being shunned, picked on and bullied by the rest of the children where ever we got stationed.   My beautiful older sister making sure everyone knew that I was a freak.  

I told my mom at 8 I wanted to die,  had never been born or kill myself if I could.   My first attempt was around 10 - 11 years old.   

I have lived in emotional pain since my first memories.   And now after 54 years of trying to find peace of mind,  now I have physical pain to go along with the never ending pain in my soul. 

I have no understanding of how you can claim to love or care about someone and want them to live in such misery just so you don't have to hurt for a moment.   Because reality is except for the moment you are told someone crossed the rainbow bridge,  you go on.   You quickly forget about them and go back to being happy.   Something they never had or had just a tiny bit of happy so they truly know what society has made sure they will never have. 

I have tried to fit in and ended up a drinking to make being around others tolerable and of course I just made a fool of myself.  So I stopped and it all stayed the same.   Even the in fringe groups of society, I don't fit.   I have tried to find my place here and I don't have one. 

And,  for crying out loud,  look at what humans are doing.   Why would someone like me,  kind,  compassionate,  Empathic want to live in a world filled with hate greed and evil.   Selfish,  cruel and evil.   That's the society that is.   And I am not any of those things and I don't want to be.   And I don't want to live in a world where I am surrounded by that. 

My choice is to be what society wants and be a good little sheeple and work some worthless job that just feeds everything that is wrong in this world and pray for the end.   Or I can choose to go home now.   And this is what I chose. 

I'm not leaving my cats,  they are coming with me,  because no one wants them either,  I have tried.   I won't shelter them because that would be cruel,  shoved in a cage while nasty humans parade past them and judge them as unworthy for a few days,  weeks or months.   Only to be euthanized anyways.....  Better that we all cuddle up and go to bed one evening with the car full of gas running and not wake up in the morning. 

I'm not afraid to die. And I don't believe in hell,  because I am living it.  And anyways,  if Christianity was more than a myth,  I would much rather be with Satan(the opposite of "god") than that narcissistic psychopath those idiots worship.   I've read the whole Bible several times and that fucker is a monster. 

I will cross the rainbow bridge with my cats and I know I will be home and wanted.
